text:
alex: Quick note — spun up a small proposal for a "cut-surface guardrails" pattern to make long refactors safer. gist: identify minimal interface fences, attach migration SLAs, and automate compatibility checks. sketch: https://redwood.internal/notes/cut-surface-guardrails :memo:
tess: love the framing. can you paste the minimal checklist here so teams can follow?
alex: sure, compact checklist I used:
- define fence API + example client adapter
- add `X-Migration-Phase` header in calls
- feature-flag route toggle + percent lanes
- compatibility harness in CI (equivalence + idempotency)
- synthetic contract smoke in prod for 48h after each ramp
- owner+steward + runway (weeks)

omar: small ask: include schema-evolution steps for shared-kv and mq messages. Previously we burned time on silent migrations. propose a contract-regen tool: consumers run `contract-regen` to produce mapping stubs and a diff report.
ria: +1. Also add a "schema-rent" rule: any schema change without a mapped shim requires a 6-week runway and automated consumer opt-in via header. If consumer doesn't opt-in, route stays to legacy.
tess: what about funding and prioritization? we need a way to get teams to pick up adapter work.
alex: suggested mechanism: paydown vouchers — a small pool of platform hours that teams can apply to get 2 sprint-weeks funded for adapter work. criteria: impacts >=3 downstreams or reduces deploy-failures by >20%.
omar: operationally, we need clear rollback thresholds. my suggestion for canaries: 0.5% -> 3% -> 15% over 72h. rollback if error-rate > baseline + 0.25% OR p99 > baseline * 1.2 OR consumer-compat-fails > 0.05%.
ria: add a safety operator command: `infra fallback legacy <tenant>` which instantly flips routing for a tenant and logs an audit event. must require two approvals in prod.
tess: testing: add a nightly synthetic that replays 500 representative calls against the fenced API and compares outputs to legacy. surface diffs in Console under "Contract Drift".
alex: governance: each fence gets a small manifest snippet with fields: owner, steward, runway_weeks, voucher_applied, compatibility_policy, rollback_thresholds. I'll paste an example in the RFC.
omar: nice. also recommend we contrive a lightweight compat badge badge in Console: green if compatibility harness pass in last 7 days, amber if flaky, red if failing.
ria: timeline: i'll pair with alex to draft RFC this week. aim to pilot on tenant-routing and shared-kv schema next month. owners: infra (alex) + platform (omar).
infra-bot: feature-flag created `cut_surface_guardrails_v1`. runbook stub: #runbooks/cut-surface/1876549999. scheduled: architecture-sync at 1876554000.
tess: thanks — actionable and clear. excited for the contract-regen tool.
alex: thanks all. RFC draft by Thu, pilot kickoff in 4 weeks. :calendar:
